messages:
morgan: midweek question — need a 3-song sequence that reliably puts you into a 20–30min nap on the couch. pls drop quick recs, bonus points for instrumental or low-vibe :zzz: 

tess: oh this is my jam. try: 1) Nils Frahm — "Says" 2) Hammock — "Turn Away and Return" 3) Goldmund — "Threnody". instrumental + reverb = instant snooze.

ramesh: for me it's less ambient, more soft-looming. recent favs: Radiohead (piano-only tracks), Sigur Rós slow ones, then a DTB ambient mix.

jun: low energy jazz helps. Chet Baker morning sessions. also white noise app if you're on a plane.

sam: vote: which vibe should morgan try first? 1) ambient/modern-classical :one: 2) downtempo electronic :two: 3) soft vocal ballads :three:

ava: ambient vote from me :one: — adding a 3-song mini-playlist i made:```1) Nils Frahm — Says
2) Ólafur Arnalds — Near Light
3) Bing & Ruth — Starwood Choker``` link: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/37i9dQZF1DX2yvmlOdMYzV (public fallback)

morgan: love these, thanks. quick Q — should I play on loop or shuffle? plane nap is timer-based so probably loop.

ramesh: loop same 3, crossfade ~6s. no sudden endings.

spike-bot: Automated reminder — please keep volume < 60% in shared spaces. :robot_face:

jun: anecdote: once napped through a 30min turbulence reading while on Nils Frahm. 10/10 — safe enough? :grimacing:

sam: lol. morgan report back after flight. film recs for post-nap? low-pressure slice-of-life movies: "Paterson", "Before Sunrise", "Lost in Translation".

morgan: will do a field test tonight on the couch. thank you all — sending results (and whether i join the :one: club). :thumbsup:
